profile.headline: Senior Frontend Software Engineer
profile.summary: Creative, analytical developer with experience in all facets of web development, requirements analysis, and user experience. Skilled in communicating with technical and non-technical audiences, including stakeholders, management, and staff to achieve technical and application objectives. Instrumental in maintaining the functionality of Java applications and developing front-end applications for customer portals. Proactively leverages deep understanding of software development best practices and design patterns, testing, validation, and CI/CD. Well-spoken professional fluent in English and Spanish.

positions.title: Lead Software Development Engineer
positions.description:
-Frontend Development in Angular, NgRx & Backend development in Java
-PostgreSQL, Hibernate, Git, Bitbucket, Docker
-AWS Lambda, Amplify, DynamoDB, S3, Cognito, CloudFront, API Gateway
-Ansible
-UI/UX Design

positions.title: Senior Software Developer
positions.description:
• Designed, created and maintained custom enterprise grade web applications and multi-factor authentication integration kits that increase security for medium to large corporations. Primarily utilized Java, Javascript, SOAP, REST, Struts, Tapestry, and Angular
• Served as the User Interface focal point. Converted all existing HTML and CSS to Bootstrap. Worked with customers to integrate and customize application seamlessly with client’s existing UI code and environment.
• Also served as the primary technological liaison to medium and large corporations to plan, deploy and troubleshoot custom applications
• Developed, refined, and tuned integrations between applications. Supported multiple technologies, some of which include RSA Adaptive Authentication OnPrem and Cloud, Ping Federate, Ping Directory (and other LDAP servers), and CA SiteMinder.
• All software was designed and implemented using the latest technology trends and utilizing Java and several frameworks, such as MVC
• Implemented design, development, and testing efforts in accordance with established standards and compliances such as HIPPA and PCI.
• Maintained high standards of software quality and security within the team by following industry's best practices.
• Prepared documentation to share with clients and team members.

positions.title: Senior Software Developer
positions.description:
Key Roles:
• Collaborated successfully with project managers, development team, product owners and business analysts.
• Created detailed Technical Design Documents and verified they were executed successfully 
• Created custom GOSU validators, business rules, front-end and back-end development for Guidewire Policy Center 
• Created JSF custom components, converters, validators, pages and managed/backing beans 
• Wrote in depth business services in Java and SQL to store and retrieve customer data across multiple tables
• Assisted peer developers with issues and was Subject Matter Expert for multiple areas of projects
• Wrote product documentation to ease maintenance of code
• Addressed and resolved critical issues for existing code through hotfixes, patches, etc.

Key Projects: 
1) Configure and Extend Guidewire PolicyCenter Insurance system 
• Worked closely with business analysts to define and develop requirements for new Policy system. 
• Defined and implemented business rules, underwriting issues, validation, Guidewire data model, UI and back-end requirements using GOSU and other Guidewire development tools.

2) Migrate DB2 Claim Data to Guidewire ClaimCenter Insurance system 
• Migrated all claims data from DB2 to specific existing Oracle tables used by the Guidewire system.  
• Guidewire tables had many requirements and restrictions.  Extensive SQL scripts were created for this project.  Data was verified through Guidewire ClaimCenter and changed accordingly based on business decisions.

3) Migrate AS400 to Web-based client insurance system
• Key contributor of development and technical design of large scale web development project in Java and JSF to completely redesign and develop web portal application used by insurance agents and home office to manage policies and customers.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Offering Lifecycle Team - Provides the support for User Interface to package assets and create offering instances to be hosted on a CSDP Platform. The Common Service Delivery Platform (CSDP) is an implementation of a 3-tired SOA architecture for building highly leveraged services solutions. Standardized solutions are constructed using a dedicated ‘product and manufacturing’ style investment development team. 

Responsibilities:
•	User Interface focal point for CSDP team
•	Assisted UI Architect with complete re-design of  OLC User Interface
•	Implemented UI using Java Server Faces (JSF) on WebSphere Portal
•	Developed Portal Themes for CSDP Platform using CSS , HTML, JSP, JavaScript
•	Involved in extensive functional and unit testing of OLC from end to end.
•	Assisted teams outside CSDP with UI design and implementation
•	Created install scripts for OLC on Portal and Process Server using wsadmin and xmlaccess scripts
•	Assisted second line manager with professional and university recruiting efforts

positions.title: Software Engineering Internship
positions.description:
Responsible for developing, executing and maintaining the software build process for multiple Java  and Java/JSF web development projects.

•	Head of Build Process for project ACME
•	Refined Build Process and wrote documentation
•	Created and Installed Enterprise Archive Files on WebSphere using Apache Ant and WebSphere tools
•	Created CGI script to facilitate use of CMVC for developers creating Java Server Pages 
•	Trained team members to use CMVC in order to complete transactions towards defects and levels.
•	Part of Functional Verification Test team
•	Wrote programs and scripts in Java, SQL and XML
